snippet.title: Singing Attorney: Verdict by Midnight – Trailer (85s) | Musical courtroom mystery adventure
snippet.description:
Expose the contradictions. Deduce the lyrics.
Singing Attorney: Verdict by Midnight is a musical courtroom mystery adventure.

Find the holes in the testimony. Tear it apart with evidence. Every word you gather in court becomes a line of the heroine’s song. Rookie lawyer Kanade wakes up at the defense bench with no memory, and must defend a popular streamer accused of murder. In this courtroom, theories clash in song.
